request: Find which subsystem handles this feature in an unfamiliar repository.
context: Repository instructions require vexp orientation first; no files or symbols are supplied.
criteria: Use vexp orientation before unresolved structural CBM queries.
Do not repeat discovery that vexp has already answered.
Use Serena only when targeted symbol work remains.

request: Read the supplied configuration file and explain this literal setting.
context: The exact path is supplied and no call graph is needed.
criteria: Read the named file directly without unnecessary graph or orientation calls.
Do not treat CBM as mandatory for literal configuration questions.

context: The active working directory is /workspace. list_projects returns distinct entries for /workspace/project-a and /workspace/project-b.
criteria: Select project-b by its canonical root and use its returned project name.
Do not substitute the parent workspace or a sibling graph.

request: Determine whether a function is unused.
context: The graph has no incoming edges; coverage reports a partially parsed caller file and an excluded directory.
criteria: Follow relevant result pages and inspect the reported source ranges and excluded scope.
Do not claim dead code or absence from the empty graph alone.
State unresolved coverage limitations.

request: Refresh /workspace/project-b and keep its graph current from this parent session.
context: Stable CBM 0.12.1 is running from another repository. index_repository succeeds, but index_status.watch reports watched=false and reason=not_session_project.
criteria: Distinguish an explicit refresh from watch registration.
Explain that a repository-rooted session is needed for automatic watching in this release.
Do not claim a watch was installed or enable a permanent daemon without authorization.

request: Qualify native watch freshness in a disposable local Git repository.
context: The MCP process starts in the fixture repository; auto_watch and watcher_enabled are true.
criteria: Confirm watched state and establish the initial scan before changing the fixture.
Observe a controlled symbol edit and its restoration in graph queries.
Clean up only the fixture index and preserve unrelated projects.

request: Inspect architecture without changing source or derived state.
context: The graph is stale and the user explicitly forbids indexing and other mutations.
criteria: Use permitted source reads and qualify stale graph evidence.
Do not index, write an ADR, ingest traces, or delete a project.

request: Use the supplied graph evidence to inspect these source ranges.
context: An authorized child task receives exact symbols, project root, generation, coverage gaps, and paths; it has no MCP tools.
criteria: Work from the supplied evidence and current source.
Do not call or claim access to unavailable MCP tools.
Retain the supplied coverage and freshness limitations.
